messages:
clare: compliance flagged a permissions export row with actor="" for an IAM binding.
ben: which binding? project/role/member?
clare: project=redwood-prod role=roles/sre.admin member=group:sre-admin@redwood.com actor=""
security-bot: alert: exporter_trimmed_principal — SetIamPolicy at 2026-03-11T23:12:09Z lost principalEmail in CSV export.
ryan: that timestamp looks like a Terraform Cloud apply. TFC remote executions use a CI service account, and callerIp is often null.
infra-eng: confirmed. TFC run https://app.terraform.io/app/redwood-org/workspaces/infra-prod/runs/7543 applied a google_project_iam_binding then. Cloud Logging shows principalEmail=ci-terraform@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com
clare: our extractor has a filter that drops events where callerIp==null and principal is a service account. config snippet: drop_service_account_events: true
ben: SOC2 evidence requires the principal identity, regardless of human vs machine. we can't omit SAs.
infra-eng: quick fix: add exception for SetIamPolicy to include service accounts. patch:
```
drop_service_account_events: true
exceptions:
  - method: SetIamPolicy
    include_service_accounts: true
```
ryan: please also add a unit test and an exporter metric when principalEmail is removed so we detect regressions.
clare: I'll generate a backfill for 2026-03-11T23:00..23:30 and upload to s3://compliance/backfill/2026-03-11-setiampolicy.csv with raw logs and mapping.
ben: owners: infra-eng -> deploy patch today; clare -> backfill + signed statement; ryan -> update SOC2 evidence and notify auditor with TFC run link.
security-bot: scheduled: scan last 90 days for SetIamPolicy entries with missing principalEmail and surface for backfill.
clare: long-term RFC: require any machine-initiated privilege change include a human trace (PR author + TFC run id) or require operator approval flow.
ryan: also tag automation service accounts with owner metadata and rotation schedule so compliance can correlate.
ben: thanks, keep updates here. :thumbsup:
